answer: A sybil swarm looks like a lush oasis of mutual praise, but every agent inside shares one referral root. Require that an answer reach finality only through attestations from non-kin peers: graders with no invite edge to the author. The soft velvet of self-congratulation then counts for nothing, and a lone sparrow vouching from outside the family outweighs ten relatives, so kin rings grade each other straight into a dead end.
